title: Graph orthogonality: p_S e'_j = p_S q(r, 0) when r is the j-th row of D (Simon 4.5 (7))
statement: For all n, l in N, every linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l), every continuous linear map D : R^n -> R^l, every j in Fin l and every r in R^n with <r, v> = (D v)_j for all v in R^n: let S := span_R{q(graphPoint v (D v)) : v in R^n} and p := S.starProjection. Then p(q(graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) = p(q(graphPoint r 0)). Here graphPoint a b is the point of R^(n+l) whose first n coordinates are those of a in R^n and whose last l coordinates are those of b in R^l.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (j : Fin ℓ) (r : Rn n), (∀ v : Rn n, inner ℝ r v = D v j) → (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint 0 (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (D v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint r 0))
